title: Langley drones were targeting NASA and a specific base location
place_text: Langley Air Force Base / NASA Langley, Virginia

tellings.quote: those drones were really targeting primarily NASA and then a very specific location on Langley Air Force Base

plain: In 2023, swarms of drones were seen over Langley in Virginia, home to an Air Force base and a NASA research center. A man named Dylan Borland, who says a top government official confided in him and speaks as someone who took part, tells Michels on the podcast American Alchemy, hosted by Jesse Michels, that the drones were not wandering: they were "really targeting primarily NASA and then a very specific location on Langley Air Force Base." If he is right, someone was deliberately probing particular sites at a sensitive military and space facility.
